title: Design: setting a rule a tier already has shows a message only
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, tier A already 35% markup in every range.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row.
  3. Check matrix A.
  4. Pick Markup % in the bar's picker.
  5. Type 35 in the bar's value.
  6. Click Set Rule.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Tiers list shows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The bar shows.

Step 4:

  • Markup % is picked.

Step 5:

  • The value reads 35.

Step 6:

  • A message at the bottom right reads tier A's name "already uses 35% markup in that matrix", as in picture 2.60.
  • The bar closes and no dialog opens.
